risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the lid(s) from above and side, showing the gasket/seal area and that the lid sits properly.

risks.risk: Food-grade/potable suitability not confirmed (material code/certification may be absent or not for food contact).

risks.risk: Capacity/size not confirmed; price depends strongly on liters (e.g., 500L vs 1000L).
risks.proof: Photo of the capacity marking (e.g., 1000L) or a clear label/dimensions with a measuring tape.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of: (1) lid(s) and gasket/seal area, (2) outlet tap/spigot connection, (3) bottom corners and seams.
Send a short video of a leak test (fill and show no dripping, ideally after some time).

response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable remotely without new visual proof. The current photo still doesn’t show the leak-prone areas, lid sealing, food-grade markings, or capacity—so pricing would be guesswork.
